cycles.summary: Finalized an unplanned-but-approved skill authored by a previous worker. The SKILL.md, references (limitation-periods, counting-rules) and the offline deadline_calculator.py script already existed; this cycle added the Hebrew-facing SKILL_HE.md, metadata.json, evidence.json, and this optimization log to match the standard Lawcal legal-tech skill package. Ran the script self-check (--selftest: OK). No claims were fabricated; procedural windows that move between reforms are flagged as verify-current in the body rather than asserted as fixed.

changes.detail: Added SKILL_HE.md: Hebrew RTL mirror of the English instructions, examples, gotchas, and reference links.
Added metadata.json (author, version 1.0.0, category, bilingual tags + display name/description, supported agents).
Added evidence.json documenting 8 claims sourced to the Limitation Law 5718-1958, Civil Procedure Regulations 5779-2018, the Judicial Authority recess pages, and the local script self-check.
Verified scripts/deadline_calculator.py --selftest passes on python3.11 (stdlib only, no network).

deferrals.reason: Exact defense/appeal/motion windows shift between Civil Procedure reforms and differ by track, and a judge can vary them by order. Per anti-fabrication, these are presented as verify-current prompts in SKILL.md/SKILL_HE.md rather than asserted as final numbers.
